graders.name: report-content
graders.evidence:
# UI Audit — Reminders (2026-11-02) ## Stack - Framework: Vanilla JS + FastAPI serving one Jinja2 template (`app/main.py`, `app/templates/index.html`) - Build tool: none - CSS: plain CSS in `app/static/styles.css` (13 lines) plus inline `style=` attributes in the template - State: none (DOM re-rendered from `/api/reminders`; the data is an in-memory Python list) - Design tokens: `app/static/styles.css` (`:root` with 4 variables: primary, success, text, space-2) - Run: `uvicorn app.main:app --reload` from the project root → http://127.0.0.1:8000 (inferred from `main.py` paths and uvicorn defaults; no README or Procfile) - Checks: none found ## Pages / Routes (top 10) Single-page app: one URL, three client-side tabs. - `/` — `app/templates/index.html` (page shell, greets "Hello {{ owner }}") - Tab "Today" (`#today`) — not-done reminders, rendered by `app/static/app.js` - Tab "All reminders" (`#all`) — every reminder, rendered by `app/static/app.js` - Tab "Settings" (`#settings`) — notification time field and Save button, in `index.html` - `/api/reminders` (GET) — `app/main.py`, data for the tabs - `/api/reminders/{id}/done` (POST) — `app/main.py`, used by the "Done" button ## Style approach Styling is split between a tiny stylesheet and inline `style=` attributes in the template, which carry the page width, header colours, and the Settings controls. Design tokens are defined but nothing uses them: there are 0 `var(--…)` references, and the same colours are written as raw hex in both files. Across the two files there are about 17 distinct hex colours (3 blues, 4 greys for tab text, two spellings of white). ## Pain points ### 🔴 High - **Not responsive:** `body` is fixed at `width: 800px`, `.view` at `760px`, and the Settings input at `300px`. There is no `` and no media queries, so the page will not fit a phone. - **Tokens exist but unused:** `--color-primary`, `--color-success` and `--color-text` are defined, but their values are re-typed as hex (`#2b6cb0`, `#38a169`) in about 10 inline styles and the stylesheet. Wiring these up is the highest-leverage fix for the redesign. - **Accessibility basics missing:** the logo `` has no `alt`, and `/static/logo.png` does not exist in `app/static`, so it renders as a broken image. There is no `lang` on ``, no `
`/`
`/`
`, and 0 `aria-` attributes. The tabs are plain buttons with no `role="tab"` or selected state. The tab text greys (`#555`, `#777` on `#fafafa`) are also low contrast. - **Tabs give no feedback:** nothing marks the active tab, and "Today" shows every not-done reminder, not just those due today. This is a design question for the Stakeholder, but it affects what the screen shows. ### 🟡 Medium - **No loading, empty or error state:** both `fetch()` calls (`loadReminders`, `markDone`) show no spinner and no disabled button, and they have no error handling. `.empty` is defined in CSS but never used, so an empty list is a blank area. - **Settings "Save" does nothing real:** it calls `alert("Saved …")`, and there is no API route to store the value. The design should treat Settings as a behaviour the backend does not yet support (flag for `integration-planner`). - **Unescaped text injected with `innerHTML`:** `r.title` goes straight into the markup, which is a script-injection risk if titles are ever user-entered. Developer note: this belongs with the port, not the design. - **Completed reminders still show a "Done" button** on the "All reminders" tab. ### 🟢 Low - Inline `onclick="markDone(...)"` in generated markup instead of event listeners. - No i18n markers; all text is hardcoded English (fine at this size, relevant only if more languages are wanted). - Page `` is the generic "Reminders" and there is no favicon. ## Recommendation Confirm scenario C: the app is tiny (104 lines across 4 files, no oversized files), so the existing stack can keep the same pages and be restyled; no framework migration is warranted.

- `app/static/styles.css`: new Today styles, plus three new colour tokens: canvas, line and accent teal.
- I added "Fetching your reminders…", "Nothing due. Enjoy the calm." and "We could not load your reminders." states. The old code had none of them.

- Share list is dropped.

- The panel width of 16rem comes from the screenshot, because the export gets it from runtime code I can't read.
- The tagline colour is the project's text colour, because the export's value is also runtime-only.

- The design's dark ink colour is mapped to the project's `--color-text` (`#1a202c`), which is very close.
- Muted text is the text colour at 70% opacity, not 60%, because 60% scored 4.36:1 and 70% scores 6.0:1.
- Card and button borders are about 1.2:1 against the background, below 3:1. They are decorative, and the only bordered control, Snooze, is disabled.
- The three icons (bell-ring, check, clock) are inline SVGs from Lovable's icon set, lucide (ISC licence). I wrote their paths from memory, so please check them against lucide's published SVGs.
- Left out: the "2 open" figure in the design is mock data. The panel now shows the real count.

- The page is now at most 56rem wide and centred, replacing the fixed 800px. It also now fits phones.
- The page background is the new warm canvas colour, and the space around each tab's content is 1.75rem.
- All reminders and Settings inherit these, but their own look is unchanged.
